question: What purpose does figurative description of the Lord serve?
premises: The supreme reality is figuratively described as having form.
This figurative treatment has a practical purpose.
Through it clarity arises quickly and leads to abiding in identity with that reality.
inference: Figurative form is used to make the Lord vivid and to support absorption into identity with him.
plain_english: This figurative treatment has a purpose: through it the bearer of qualities becomes clear quickly, and one comes to abide in identity with that reality.
